items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: He was there. I don't remember hearing him. I don't remember. Do you remember the name?

ctx.x: Yeah, that made me really miss a lot of the poor times. I was just by the stage to be mingling with them, you know? But anyhow, getting around them, anyhow, 19, 20 years old. I knew I was going to start getting around them, because I was very interested in my music, you know? I knew I was going to start getting around them, but I was drafted to the service. Must have been about 19, 20 years old then when I was drafted to the service.

One pianist they talk about, I don't know how long he was around here, Udell Wilson, I think he came from Kansas City. Did you ever hear him? Wilson? Udell Wilson, yeah, he played, oh, in the late, about the time you were born. I guess he was growing strong. I don't know if he stayed here long enough for you to hear him or died. I don't know if he was there.
He was there. I don't remember hearing him. I don't remember. Do you remember the name?
